title: Berberine ameliorate inflammation and apoptosis via modulating PI3K/AKT/NFkappaB and MAPK pathway on dry eye.
authors: Han, Yi; Guo, Shujia; Li, Yunpeng; Li, Jiani; Zhu, Linfangzi; Liu, Yuwen; Lv, Yufei; Yu, Dong; Zheng, Lan; Huang, Caihong; Li, Cheng; Hu, Jiaoyue; Liu, Zuguo
journal: Phytomedicine : international journal of phytotherapy and phytopharmacology
one_liner_zh: 该文研究小檗碱通过PI3K/AKT/NFkappaB和MAPK通路改善干眼症炎症与凋亡，核心是药物-蛋白通路而非蛋白质-DNA互作，且无AI或物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: BACKGROUND: Dry eye disease (DED) is a multifactorial disease in ocular surface, and inflammation plays an etiological role. Berberine (BBR) has shown efficacy in treating inflammatory diseases. Yet, there was no adequate information related to the therapeutic effects of BBR for DED. PURPOSE: To detect the effects and explore the potential mechanisms of BBR on DED. STUDY DESIGN: In vitro, in vivo study and network pharmacology analysis were involved. METHOD: The human corneal epithelium cells viability was evaluated with different concentrations of BBR. Dry eye murine model was established by exposing to the desiccating stress, and Ciclosporin (CSA), BBR eye drops or vehicle were topical administration for 7 days. The phenol red cotton tests, Oregon-green-dextran staining and Periodic acid-Schiff staining were performed and evaluated the dry eye after treatment. Inflammation and apoptosis levels of ocular surface were quantified. The potential targets related to berberine and dry eye were collected from databases. The Protein-Protein interaction network analysis and GO & KEGG enrichment analysis were realized by STRING database, Metascape platform and Cytoscape software to find core targets and signaling pathways. The SchrOdinger software was used to molecular docking and PyMOL software to visualization. Finally, the levels of PI3K/AKT/NFkappaB and MAPK pathways were detected. RESULT: The data revealed BBR could rescue impaired HCE under hyperosmotic conditions. In addition, BBR eye drops could ameliorate dry eye. And BBR eye drops suppressed the inflammatory factors and CD4(+)T cells infiltration in conjunctiva. Besides, BBR eye drops protected ocular surface by avoiding the severe apoptosis and decreasing the level of MMP-3 and MMP-9. 148 common targets intersection between BBR and dry eye were found via network pharmacology analysis. Core proteins and core pathways were identified through PPI and GO&KEGG enrichment analysis. Molecular docking displayed excellent binding between BBR and those core targets. Finally, in vivo study verified that BBR eye drops had a therapeutic effect in dry eye by inhibiting PI3K/AKT/NFkappaB and MAPK pathways. CONCLUSION: The research provided convincing evidence that BBR could be a candidate drug for dry eye.
abstract_zh: 背景：干眼病（DED）是一种眼表多因素疾病，炎症在其发病机制中起病因作用。小檗碱（Berberine, BBR）在治疗炎症性疾病中已显示出疗效。然而，关于BBR对DED治疗效果的信息尚不充分。目的：检测BBR对DED的作用并探讨其潜在机制。研究设计：涉及体外研究、体内研究和网络药理学分析。方法：评估不同浓度BBR下的人角膜上皮细胞活力。通过暴露于干燥应激建立干眼小鼠模型，并局部给予环孢素（Ciclosporin, CSA）、BBR滴眼液或赋形剂治疗7天。采用酚红棉线试验、俄勒冈绿-葡聚糖染色和过碘酸-雪夫染色评估治疗后干眼情况。量化眼表的炎症和凋亡水平。从数据库中收集与小檗碱和干眼相关的潜在靶点。通过STRING数据库、Metascape平台和Cytoscape软件实现蛋白质-蛋白质相互作用网络分析及GO&KEGG富集分析，以寻找核心靶点和信号通路。使用Schrödinger软件进行分子对接，PyMOL软件进行可视化。最后，检测PI3K/AKT/NFkappaB和MAPK通路的水平。结果：数据显示BBR在高渗条件下能挽救受损的HCE细胞。此外，BBR滴眼液能改善干眼症状。BBR滴眼液抑制了结膜中的炎症因子和CD4(+)T细胞浸润。此外，BBR滴眼液通过避免严重凋亡和降低MMP-3及MMP-9水平来保护眼表。通过网络药理学分析发现BBR与干眼之间有148个共同靶点。通过PPI和GO&KEGG富集分析确定了核心蛋白和核心通路。分子对接显示BBR与这些核心靶点之间具有优异的结合能力。最后，体内研究验证了BBR滴眼液通过抑制PI3K/AKT/NFkappaB和MAPK通路对干眼具有治疗作用。结论：本研究提供了有力证据，表明BBR可能是干眼的候选药物。
